column6: Celeste is a tight platformer about climbing a mountain while overcoming self-doubt.\nIt is a great demo game because it has a clear title, strong cover art, and a high rating.

ULTRAKILL is a fast-paced retro-style FPS with movement-heavy combat, stylish scoring, and intense arena battles.\nIt works well in the catalog because it stands out from the platformers and sports games.
Call of Duty is a World War II first-person shooter and the first game in the long-running series.\nIt is useful for showing older games, shooter tags, and classic favorites in a user library.

Stardew Valley is a farming and life simulation game where players grow crops, build friendships, fish, mine, and decorate their farm.\nIt is a strong demo title for showing cozy games and long playtimes.
FIFA 22 is a soccer game with career mode, ultimate team, online play, and matchday presentation.\nIt is useful for showing sports games in user libraries.
FIFA 07 is an older soccer title that helps show how the app can store classic games alongside newer releases.
Hollow Knight is a hand-drawn action adventure game focused on exploration, boss fights, and discovering a ruined underground kingdom.
Hades is a fast roguelike action game where each escape attempt adds new story, upgrades, and combat choices.
Grand Theft Auto V is an open-world action game with story missions, driving, exploration, and online multiplayer.
The Witcher 3 is an open-world RPG known for story quests, exploration, player choices, and a large fantasy world.
